description: Chinon于1988年推出的胶片相机。配备35 mm f/3,9 (3 elements/3 groups).。快门速度Programmed electronic shutter, 1/90–1/410 s.。使用Automatic advance and rewind.。感光度DX coded films from ISO 100 to 1000. Non-DX films exposed as ISO 100.。Infrared autofocus, from 1,3 m to infinity. Prefocus possible.。

specs.对焦: Infrared autofocus, from 1,3 m to infinity. Prefocus possible.
specs.闪光灯: Built-in, manually activated. GN 10. Range: 1,3–3,5 m. Fill flash possible.
specs.取景器: Bright frames with LED indicators for low light and focus.
specs.感光度: DX coded films from ISO 100 to 1000. Non-DX films exposed as ISO 100.
specs.英文简介: Chinon Splash AF is a weather-proof compact autofocus camera released in 1988.
